g.text: Four temporary job containers; one operator command runs, validates and activates the new release; rollback to the previous version is kept. Originals stay unchanged.
Pause or throttle batch work under load.
Each release keeps prepared documents, metadata and a matching Qdrant collection.
After validation, publish the bundle and switch the authoritative GCS pointer.
Readers pin one release; failed activation leaves the previous release available.
Development uses a filesystem pointer; ingestion owns its job reports.
Implemented in source: shared BGE, four jobs, release pinning, GCS activation and rollback.
See the roadmap for container acceptance and cloud deployment status.
